resources.name: Al lattice crystal structures (fcc, bcc, hcp, sc, spinel, gra-e1, gra-e, gra-a)

access.notes: Space groups and atomic positions are fully described in the paper; the agent constructs the input unit cells from public knowledge.

resources.name: Plane-wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, VASP, ABINIT)

access.notes: Open-source equivalent is acceptable. Must support GGA functional and accurate total energies.

resources.name: Equation-of-state fitting tool (GIBBS or self-developed script)

access.notes: Optional; the solver may implement its own fitting routines.

resources.name: AIM topological analysis code (e.g., Henkelman's Bader, AIMAll, CRITIC)

access.notes: Any code capable of locating bond, ring, and cage critical points from electron density grids.

resources.name: All-electron or PAW-reconstructed DFT wavefunction generator

access.notes: Must produce the electron density needed for AIM analysis; any accurate all-electron or PAW-reconstruction scheme works.
